description: The quick simulation (expected values from the spec, instant): what each box, ticket and craft gives back against its price, the house edge, each pool’s money in and out per day and whether it runs dry, settles or grows, farm rewards per unit staked, what players, the treasury and the platform get each day. `scenario` overrides the spec’s own ({"perDay": {"box:flip": 1000}, "days": 30, "staked": {"<farm>": 1000}}). Quote its numbers; never your own arithmetic.

example.description: A worked example by name, from xsolana_examples (coin-flip-arena, stud-farm, …).

file.description: A JSON file holding the spec, relative to the project folder (default: xsolana.json when it exists).

scenario.description: What to assume instead of the spec’s scenario.

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_simulate
